gripOrHq.title: Project Babylon
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Vapor Ops
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

discardCards.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Cloak
discardCards.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

discardCards.title: Sneak Preview
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.
